reason: 근로기준법 제61조 windows are now enforced server-side. The push endpoints need the statutory inputs the windows are counted from, and must stop accepting an unverifiable unused-day count that ends up printed on a legal notice.
note_for_integrator: Without this the endpoints reject every current caller with 422 (missing track / leave_period_end). That is fail-closed and correct, but it means the console 촉진 button errors until the web caller is updated too — see manifests/web.json.

track.description: Which §61 window set applies. annual = 제61조제1항 (제60조제1항·제2항·제4항 연차). first_year_early = 제61조제2항제1호 본문 (계속근로 1년 미만, 1차 촉구 이전 발생분). first_year_late = 제61조제2항제1호 단서 (1차 촉구 이후 발생분). The paragraphs have different periods, so this cannot be defaulted.

leave_period_end.description: 제60조제7항 본문에 따른 기간의 마지막 날 (§61② tracks: 최초 1년의 근로기간 종료일). Every statutory window is counted back from this date.

designated_dates.description: The 사용 시기 a round-2 notice designates (§61제1항제2호 requires the 통보 to designate them). Required and non-empty when round = 2; must be absent or empty for round 1.

changes.note: The refusal does NOT take designated_dates: it quotes the dates recorded on the 2차 통보 it follows, read back from that notice.

changes.description_replace: Requires `employee_directory_manage` in the target `branch_id` (validated against the actor's scope). The push is checked against 근로기준법 제61조 before anything is delivered: round 1 must fall inside its statutory window (§61①1: 사용기간 종료 6개월 전 기준 10일 이내 — for a 1/1–12/31 회계연도, 7/1~7/10), and round 2 must follow a recorded round 1 by more than the worker's 10-day reply period and land on or before the 2차 통보 기한 (§61①2: 종료 2개월 전 — 10/31). §61② tracks use 3개월/1개월 and 1개월/10일 respectively. A push outside its window is refused, never delivered. The unused-day count is read from the authoritative roster, not from the request. Idempotent per (target, kind, round) within one 연차 사용기간.

responses_add.409: Ordering or evidence conflict — round 2 without a recorded 1차 촉구, a refusal without a recorded 2차 통보, an employee whose 미사용 연차 일수 the roster has not established, or a push for a different 연차 사용기간 than the one already recorded.

responses_replace.422: Outside the §61 statutory window, or the notice's required content is missing (round 2 with no designated 사용 시기, round 1 with designated dates, unparsable track / leave_period_end).

changes.description_replace: Requires `employee_directory_manage` in the target `branch_id`. Must follow a recorded 2차 통보 for the same 연차 사용기간; refuses labour on exactly the dates that 통보 designated. The notice records the employer's refusal — it does NOT assert that the 미사용수당 obligation is extinguished, because §61 relief additionally depends on facts this system cannot observe (대법원 2019다279283).

responses_add.409: No recorded 2차 통보 for this employee and 연차 사용기간, or that 통보 designated no dates.
responses_add.422: Served before the 2차 통보, after the 연차 사용기간 ended, or with unparsable track / leave_period_end.
